observations.description: Path resolution: backslash normalization, no absolute paths, no drive letters, no parent traversal, must resolve to file inside repository. resolve(strict=True) catches nonexistent paths.
Duplicate and regressing timestamps reject. JSONL duplicates also reject.
Gaps reported as UNCLASSIFIED_ARCHIVE_DISCONTINUITY without fabricating bars. Multiple gaps all reported.

CSV: UTF-8-sig decode, exact header check, is_closed==true required, OHLCV validation, UTC timestamps. JSONL: JSON decode, required field check, window_start_ns validation (non-bool, non-negative, multiple of 1e9).
Market/timeframe contamination: row market must match, timeframe must match. Unsupported markets (only BTC/ES/NQ) and timeframes (only 1m/5m/15m/1h/4h) reject.
Duration: JSONL must be 1m. Close-open must equal _DURATIONS[timeframe]. Bad duration rejects.
Unfinished candles: is_closed must be 'true' (case-insensitive). False rejects.
NaN/Infinity: _decimal rejects bool, non-str/int, non-finite Decimal. JSONL NaN also rejects.
OHLCV: high>=max(open,close), low<=min(open,close), high>=low, volume>=0. All violations reject.
Empty files reject. Header-only (no rows) rejects. Empty JSONL rejects.
Deterministic: scan_id=canonical_fingerprint over immutable values. Repeated scan produces identical result. trading_authority=False. Frozen dataclass.

EvidenceFileV1: relative_path, sha256 (exact bytes), byte_count, record_count, timeframe, start_inclusive (first open), end_exclusive (last close). MissingIntervalV1: timeframe, start (prev+duration), end (actual open), reason.
No network/credential/recorder/strategy/trading imports. Only csv, dataclass, datetime, decimal, enum, hashlib, io, json, pathlib used.
Non-UTC timestamps reject (timezone-aware non-UTC and naive both reject). Malformed timestamps reject.
Documentation: read-only, trading_authority=false, no provider/network, futures unclassified, frozen-only, actively growing not OOS evidence.
